config.label: Contact email the EBI Job Dispatcher requires to submit InterProScan jobs
config.description: Contact email the EBI Job Dispatcher requires to submit InterProScan jobs. Optional: without it interpro_scan_sequence still returns precalculated matches for sequences already in UniParc and fails other sequences as scan_not_configured, and interpro_get_scan_result still reads existing jobs. EBI stores the address with job data for seven days, and one address covers every caller of the server.
